title: Phone screens, round 2 — Backup & sync folded, smarter message times

steps.path: Settings → Backup & sync, on a phone
steps.headline: On a phone, Additional backups is one row, so Backup & sync fits on one screen.
steps.changed: Your D-4 answer. The row names where the extra copy goes and how it is doing ("Google Drive, backed up 5m ago"), or "Off". If an extra copy has a problem, the row says "Problem with Google Drive" and opens by itself.
steps.measured: Backup & sync about 140 px shorter on a 390 px phone
steps.notice: Main backup and History are visible without scrolling.
steps.risk: Pausing the extra copy or adding a destination takes one more tap. The computer is unchanged.

steps.path: Settings → Backup & sync → tap Additional backups, on a phone
steps.headline: Tapping the row opens everything the section shows today, inside the same box.
steps.changed: The same switch, destinations, Add a backup and Back up all now, in the fold-out box style used elsewhere in settings.
steps.notice: Tap the row again to fold it.
steps.risk: The switch sits one line lower than the row's title, inside the opened box.

steps.path: Any conversation, on a phone (with message times turned on in Appearance)
steps.headline: On a phone, only the times that tell you something are shown; tap any message to see its time.
steps.changed: Your D-5 idea. A message keeps its time when it is the newest one, or the first after a pause of 30 minutes or more, or the first on a new day. Every other time is hidden until you tap that message; tap again to hide it. Taps on links and buttons inside a message work as before.
steps.notice: In the picture only the first and newest messages keep their time, since the rest were sent minutes apart. In a conversation you come back to, the first message of each sitting shows when you came back.
steps.risk: Tapping a message to see its time is not obvious; nothing on screen hints at it. Tapping text you meant to select does nothing new. The computer still shows every time. Tap behaviour is not in these pictures; you can try it on the phone once I install it.
